duzeltme.govde: [BC ONLY] (Graphing calculator allowed.) Let $R$ be the region enclosed by the spiral $r=1+\frac{\theta}{2}$ for $0\le\theta\le2\pi$ and the segment of the positive $x$-axis from $x=1$ to $x=1+\pi$. For $0\lt k\lt2\pi$, the part of $R$ swept out by the radius as $\theta$ goes from $0$ to $k$ (the part between the rays $\theta=0$ and $\theta=k$) has exactly half the area of $R$. To the nearest thousandth, what is $k$?
